description: The state's new data center policy doesn't just offer incentives for green power, it requires 51% of it. That's a significantly different approach from other states.
body_lead: Gujarat notified the Viksit Gujarat Data Center Policy 2026-29 on August 7, targeting 7.5 GW of hyperscale “Green AI” data center capacity by 2029, anchored around the Dholera Special Investment Region, which the state wants developed into one of the world's largest hyperscale green AI data center hubs.
